requiredStatusCheckAdditionalGate.changedFileEvidence: exact base/head commit and recursive Git tree SHA comparison; mutable pull-request files listing is corroboration only
requiredStatusCheckAdditionalGate.trustRootMaintenance: separate Owner-controlled procedure; no bypass actor is proposed

continuingFreshness.platformLimit: A GitHub check success has no decision-expiry predicate. Scheduled/API invalidation is asynchronous and can fail or race a merge; App uninstall/key revocation does not prove historical success is invalidated.
continuingFreshness.activationBlocker: Separately reviewed final merge admission must close continuing-freshness/TOCTOU requirements before required-check success or enforcing main protection can be enabled.

staleApprovalHandling.githubReviewApprovals: dismiss on reviewable push; zero required approvals and no code-owner or last-push approval requirement
staleApprovalHandling.independentReports: changed head, base, source, policy, evidence, or decision bindings require new exact-head review/authorization
staleApprovalHandling.decisionRevocation: invalid, expired, revoked, closed, changed, or unreadable authorization cannot produce App success; best-effort sweep invalidates old success without renewing it

outagePolicy.apiFailure: no successful required signal; prior success removal cannot be guaranteed while API is unavailable
outagePolicy.installationRevoked: no successful required signal; authenticate installation restoration and read back all historical check invalidation
outagePolicy.operatorResponse: freeze merges and auto-merge/queue; use separately authorized Owner settings recovery if needed; never synthesize green or add bypass

recovery.actor: markd3ng Owner account with repository administration; distinct from publisher installation token
recovery.channel: repository Settings / Rulesets or authenticated ruleset management API, independent of branch updates and App check health
recovery.operation: separately authorized temporary disable of exact ruleset ID; repair only exact reviewed trusted-root change; restore exact ruleset and read back all effective rules before reopening merges
recovery.lockoutRisk: Activating a required check whose success is disabled blocks every ordinary merge. A repair PR cannot satisfy the protected-path gate; Owner settings recovery must work independently before activation.

liveConsumptionGate: Do not apply this ruleset: the required check deliberately cannot succeed and activation would lock out ordinary merges. A schedule cannot establish atomic expiry/revocation at merge. Complete a separately reviewed final admission design, real App/check/Environment/recovery verification and exact Owner activation decision first. R3 consumption and PR133 merge remain unauthorized.
